doc.hypothesis: A model of a Rs 10 lakh market order's cost from what the book shows at the decision (half-spread, how much of the order the visible five levels cover, the stock's turnover, time of day, side) predicts the measured cost better than the turnover-band averages now in production.
doc.data: H1 entry samples (intraday_h1_samples, phase 'entry', measurable), 12 Oct - 3 Nov 2026, joined to that day's stored universe turnover.
doc.model: Ordinary least squares on cost_bp_vs_ltp with features: half_spread_bp, depth_covered_pct, insufficient_depth (0/1), log10(turnover crore), minutes since 09:15, minutes squared, side (BUY=1). Training targets winsorised at the training sample's 1st and 99th percentiles.
doc.baseline: The production form rebuilt from the TRAINING samples only: 10%-trimmed mean cost per turnover band (>= 1,000 / 300-1,000 / 150-300 / < 150 crore).
doc.metric: Mean absolute error on the test samples (targets not winsorised).
doc.decision: ADOPT for live order decisions (market vs limit, order size cap) only if the model's test MAE <= 0.90 x the baseline's. Otherwise keep the band model. Paper fills keep the band model either way until a forward check.
